title: UPDATE: Interfaze AI Accused of Copying Chandra OCR 2 for Alleged First of Kind Model
summary:
Developer Vik Paruchuri has alleged that the interfaze-1-lite system is a rebranded version of a separate OCR tool with a modified license. Paruchuri claims on October 7 that Interfaze AI copied the Chandra OCR 2 model and degraded its output performance, citing an olmocr score of 83.8 for the new model compared to 85.8 for the original system.

Interfaze AI released interfaze-1-lite on October 5 as a general open-weight model for deterministic work, including classification, extraction, and speech-to-text. The tool is designed to provide metadata and confidence scores, such as bounding boxes, for every run to ensure predictable results.
